'''Galbrait''' was the leader of the female [[Ayyad]]. 

==Activities==
During the [[Last Battle]] [[Demandred]] sends her and other Ayyad to destroy Mat's command post; when Galbrait reports to the Forsken how she failed, she feels pain for failing to kill him.

== Trivia ==
* Galbrait is named for Stefanie Galbraith Coombs, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
